sharedconfig.ini.info: Main shared Darkflame Universe settings. The container writes the GSA environment values into this file at startup.

authconfig.ini.info: Authentication server config. Keep the default auth port unless you have also customized client-side connection behavior.

chatconfig.ini.info: Chat server config. The default chat port used by the wrapper is 2005/udp.

masterconfig.ini.info: Master server config. The wrapper runs MasterServer.exe and lets Darkflame spawn the child services.

worldconfig.ini.info: World server config. The wrapper writes GSA's assigned query port as Darkflame world_port_start.

external_ip.name: External IP
external_ip.info: Public IP advertised to LEGO Universe clients. Default uses the GameServerApp machine IP.

client_net_version.name: Client Net Version
client_net_version.info: Use 171022 for the common LEGO Universe 1.10.64 client. Use 171023 only for a Darkflame Universe client build that expects it.

database_type.name: Database Type
database_type.info: SQLite keeps the GSA server self-contained. MariaDB requires a separate database service and matching MYSQL_* environment variables.

skip_account_creation.name: Skip Interactive Account Check
skip_account_creation.info: Keep enabled for non-interactive GameServerApp startup. Create the first admin account with Create-Admin.ps1.

log_to_console.name: Log To Console
log_to_console.info: Mirrors Darkflame log output to the Docker log for GameServerApp.

master_ip.name: Master IP
master_ip.info: Internal master server IP. Keep localhost for the all-in-one container.

master_server_port.name: Master Server Port
master_server_port.info: Internal Darkflame master server port. This is not normally exposed publicly.

prestart_servers.name: Prestart Servers
prestart_servers.info: Autostart auth, chat, and character services when MasterServer starts.

dont_use_keys.name: Ignore Play Keys
dont_use_keys.info: Allows accounts to log in without LEGO Universe play keys. Recommended for test servers.

rewardcodes.name: Default Reward Codes
rewardcodes.info: Reward codes applied to accounts by default. Upstream defaults are 4,30.

chat_web_server_enabled.name: Chat Web Server
chat_web_server_enabled.info: Darkflame chat web server toggle. Keep disabled for the normal game server.

mysql_host.name: MariaDB Host
mysql_host.info: Only used when Database Type is MariaDB.

mysql_database.name: MariaDB Database
mysql_database.info: Only used when Database Type is MariaDB.

mysql_username.name: MariaDB Username
mysql_username.info: Only used when Database Type is MariaDB.

mysql_password.name: MariaDB Password
mysql_password.info: Only used when Database Type is MariaDB.
